Author: t3sco (based on Mappy by MidoriKami, harbingerftw)
Name: Gratis
Description: Replaces the in-game map with a flat, minimal ImGui map: search, lenses, filters, travel offers, window presets and dozens of small QoL tweaks. Based on Mappy by MidoriKami and harbingerftw. Open with /gratis.
Changelog: Everything where you'd look for it: an Essentials settings tab with sub-tabs, Show advanced and one-click presets; a Changelog tab and a What's new window after updates; Quick setup looks that recolour the map; a tidier Quest Log whose Show on map leads somewhere reachable; an up-one-level button on the location card; Nearby and expansion cards with game art; calmer tooltips and scrollbars; easier window corners. Hovering the Quest Log no longer stops your character moving.
